entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
This is unbelievable. Just get me a person already!
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Charlie, I need to return this VeloBand sensor. It's practically brand new and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into a return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
The issue is I don't want it! And don't give me some runaround about how it's too late. I know how you companies work. You'll blame some new policy or bring up hygiene as an excuse to keep my money.

I understand your concern about the return process, sir. Our policy does have guidelines for sanitation on wearable products. Can I get your order number so I can check the specific terms for your item?
Fine! It's VF-8675309. But I swear, if you deny this, I'm demanding a manager and I will plaster negative reviews everywhere. I'm not playing games.

Thank you. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for one VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th, which was 35 days ago. One moment while I review the policy for this specific device.
Actually, I have good news for you. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor has a 90-day return window. Since you're only at day 35, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund. No problem at all.
Wait, what? Really? Ninety days? So you'll take it back?

Absolutely. I've just approved the return in our system. I am emailing a prepaid return label to the address we have on file right now. Just package the sensor back in its box, apply the label, and you can drop it in the mail. We'll process your full refund as soon as we receive it.
Oh. Well... okay then. That was... much easier than I expected. Thank you.
You're very welcome. I'm happy I could get that sorted out for you quickly. Was there anything else I could assist with today?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
